tools.name: animation_cancel_draft
tools.description: Cancel and discard the current native animation draft.

tools.name: animation_cancel_session
tools.description: Cancel the authoring session and stop preview, confirmation and draft state.

tools.name: animation_capture_view
tools.description: Return an actual retained camera image as MCP image content with matching camera matrices, joint projections, rig fingerprint, revision and timestamp.

tools.name: animation_commit_draft
tools.description: Commit a draft through the trusted native MCP path with authorization bound to the exact request and document digest.

tools.name: animation_create_draft
tools.description: Create an empty draft for the current live rig; requires native authoring opt-in.

tools.name: animation_export_draft
tools.description: Export the current authored draft as AnimationDocument v1.

tools.name: animation_import_draft
tools.description: Import and validate an AnimationDocument v1 draft for the current live rig.

tools.name: animation_observe_pose
tools.description: Capture one synchronized pose from 1..6 hidden model cameras and return live joint projection metadata. Requires the draft_id returned by animation_create_draft.

tools.name: animation_preview_draft
tools.description: Start or stop the native viewport preview for the current draft.

tools.name: animation_session_status
tools.description: Read the current authoring session, live rig fingerprint, preview and permission state.

tools.name: animation_set_bone_keyframes
tools.description: Atomically replace one live-rig bone channel at an expected draft revision.

tools.name: animation_undo_commit
tools.description: Undo an authored animation revision after digest-bound native user approval.

tools.name: animation_validate_draft
tools.description: Validate the current draft against the live rig and AnimationDocument v1 rules.

tools.name: animations_list
tools.description: List loaded or configured animation metadata without clip data.

tools.name: application_get_status
tools.description: Read the current Mesh2Motion application phase and version.

includeDiagnostics.description: Include the diagnostics-enabled flag. This never enables diagnostics.

tools.name: renderer_get_state
tools.description: Read measured WebGL and render-loop state; unavailable fields are omitted.

tools.name: rigs_list
tools.description: List configured rig names and bundle-relative asset keys.

includeAssetPaths.description: Reserved for a future permission-gated debug mode; currently denied.

modelAsset.description: A bundle-relative asset key only; never an absolute filesystem path.

tools.name: scene_inspect
tools.description: Read safe scene counts, names, and camera position; never returns geometry or paths.

tools.name: skeleton_get_catalog
tools.description: Read the current live rig and bone catalog from the native Three.js skeleton.
